outcome: alterations in morphology and external or internal organs
cohort: The study utilized mature female and male BALB/c mice (25-30 g) for experimental administration of carbamazepine.
finding: Higher oral doses of carbamazepine (600 mg/kg) in BALB/c mice were associated with increased fetal loss, significantly reduced birth weight, stunted physical development, and structural abnormalities in the fetuses.
birth_weight: CBZ-exposed fetuses: 0.71 +- 0.06 g; Control fetuses: 1.67 +- 0.12 g (measured in mice)
